sources.title: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型 / Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_zh: 美團發布了一款從未使用過輝達 GPU 的 1.6 兆參數代理模型
sources.title_en: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.title_original: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU
sources.summary: Meituan has released the weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter model built for AI agents and trained entirely on Chinese hardware. On Terminal Bench, it scores 88.4 points, landing just behind Claude Opus 5. The sample deployment runs on 194 Huawei Ascend chips, and Meituan makes no mention of Nvidia GPUs. The article Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 美團已發布 LongCat-2.5 的權重，這是一款專為 AI 代理打造、擁有 1.6 兆參數的模型，且完全在中國硬體上訓練。在 Terminal Bench 上，它獲得了 88.4 分，僅落後於 Claude Opus 5。範例部署運行在 194 個 華為 昇騰（Ascend）晶片上，且美團未提及輝達（Nvidia）GPU。
